name: baseline-calibrated
architecture: DenseNet121 (ImageNet pretrained) -> GlobalAveragePooling2D -> Dropout -> Dense(14, activation='sigmoid')
preprocessing: 1. Load PNG as grayscale. 2. Apply CLAHE (clipLimit=2.0, tileGridSize=(8,8)). 3. Resize to 224x224. 4. Replicate grayscale channel to 3 channels (RGB). 5. Apply tf.keras.applications.densenet.preprocess_input (torch-style: scale to [0,1], normalize by ImageNet per-channel mean/std).
notes: Same weights as v1 (baseline_best.keras). Apply temperature scaling at inference: calibrated_prob = sigmoid(logit(raw_model_output) / 1.098). Temperature fitted on VALIDATION set, evaluated honestly on test set. ECE improved from 0.0159 to 0.0147. IMPORTANT: calibration improves probability trustworthiness, NOT medical accuracy - AUC is unchanged from v1 (temperature scaling is a monotonic transform, doesn't affect ranking).
